snippet.title: Microvania | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

The tiniest modern metroidvania you’ve ever seen is coming to Nintendo Switch! Experience all of this retro action platformer with its miniscule world full of upgrades, hidden paths and tough bosses for the first time on a console platform in late 2025!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3114890/Microvania/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
